records.subject: You're in -- let's get Willow Group set up
records.body:
Hi Tunde,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *Willow Group* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Kickoff held 6/23 [calendar:2afa320a] shows intent, but 5 days later no project, no invite, no milestone, and no customer reply since the welcome email [email:97d5627c]. No tickets, so no signal of active use. Post-kickoff silence on Starter with 8 days left makes unaided activation unlikely but not negligible.

draft.subject: Picking up where our kickoff left off
draft.body:
Hi Tunde,

Good to talk at last week's kickoff. Since then I haven't seen a first project in Willow Group's account yet, so I wanted to check in before things get busy again.

Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting one in place is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd like to try it solo.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
